Report Refinement was introduced to automatically improve grammar, terminology, punctuation, clarity, and readability across radiology reports. This enhancement ensures that clinical meaning, measurements, laterality, and core document structure are strictly preserved while streamlining the final review process for radiologists.

Impression Generation has been added to create or regenerate concise, prioritized Impression or Conclusion sections. This enhancement delivers a focused synthesis directly from documented findings without introducing unsupported diagnoses, recommendations, or follow-up advice.

‍

## What they do

Impression generation creates or regenerates only the impression or conclusion section based on the documented findings. It produces a concise, prioritized synthesis without adding diagnoses, recommendations, follow-up instructions, or unsupported information.

Report refinement improves the grammar, terminology, punctuation, clarity, and readability throughout the report, preserving its clinical meaning, measurements, laterality, headings, and structure.

## Clinical value and use

These actions help the radiologist produce clearer, more consistent documentation from dictated or incomplete reports. Impression generation reduces the effort needed to synthesize findings, while report refinement improves text quality without altering the radiologist's judgment.

## Effect on the physician's workflow

These tools reduce repetitive editing and rewriting. The radiologist remains the author and final reviewer, while the AI handles narrowly scoped writing and formatting tasks in a predictable and safe manner, thereby reducing the effort required to produce a high-quality report.
